div.div:
🚪 AWS API Gateway
Public Endpoint
Features:
• JWT Authorizer (Okta)
Validates token signature & expiry
Rejects invalid tokens before hitting backend
• Throttling & Rate Limiting
Limits requests per second per client
Prevents API abuse & DDoS attacks
• AWS WAF Protection
Blocks SQL injection, XSS attacks
IP whitelisting/blacklisting rules
• API Keys & Usage Plans
Track usage per client/partner
Enforce quota limits (e.g., 10K calls/day)
• Request/Response Logging
CloudWatch integration for audit
Debug & troubleshoot API issues

2. API Request + Bearer Token
REQUEST ->
GET https://<awsAPIGateway>/v1/campaigns
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
Content-Type: application/json

div.div:
1. Get JWT Access Token
REQUEST ->
POST https://<companyName>.okta.com/oauth2/default/v1/token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
grant_type=client_credentials&
client_id=<client_id>&
client_secret=<client_secret>&
scope=campaigns:read campaigns:write
RESPONSE ->
{
"access_token": "xxxxx",
"token_type": "Bearer",
"expires_in": 3600,
"scope": "campaigns:read campaigns:write"
}
